column3: Manami's Smile
Today was fun～
You're happy just like that?
Yes, of course. Thank you very much, Kyou-chan.
I should be the one thanking you.
I really had fun. So I can at least express my gratitude～
You've been accommodating to my schedule; how much of a goody-goody are you?
I don't know why, but I've taken a liking to Kyoto.
Kyoto really does suit you.
Do you mean like an apprentice geisha?
I'm saying you're just like a senior citizen.
But, she probably has been looking forward to today.
Seeing how she worn out her guidebook...
What am I compared to her?
What can I do for her?
Should I treat you? To thank you for today.
Eh, are you sure?
Yes, anything's fine.
Hmm, then....
Let's take a photo together.
Hey... You're okay with just that?
Yes.
I see. Got it, let's take it.
Yay! Then...
Manami got her cell phone out, put her face close to mine-- Hmf, it's too close...
Okay, say Cheese!
--And like that, I made a commemorative picture with Manami.
Without decoration, inexpensive, just a photo of our faces...
But even so, after seeing Manami so happy about it, I'm glad we took it.
Really, these kinds of "normal" things are the ones that match my character.
...N-No. I can't think of anything at all...
...I-I'm sorry for calling you out this late.
Nah, it's nothing...
We'll need to wake up early tomorrow, so I'm heading to bed.
Y-Yeah.
S-See you then! Good night, Kyou-chan.
